overrides.purpose: Minimal system-integrity successor to V24. V25 preserves the frozen baseline, complete state/card/legal-action context, CoT route behavior, memory semantics, retrieval, injection and reflection schedules. When a reflection response is empty or output-truncated, its bounded format retry now receives the same complete evidence instead of an information-free empty-body repair request. Ordinary nonempty JSON syntax errors retain syntax-only repair. Seed manifests hash every memory snapshot and seed-specific audit rows; arm manifests hash the final memory store and audit log. V24 remains an immutable pre-acceptance artifact.

memory.reflection_retry_contract: Nonempty non-truncated malformed JSON uses syntax-only repair. Empty or finish_reason=length output uses the existing bounded retry budget to regenerate from the identical complete evidence plus a compact-JSON instruction; no evidence is omitted and no semantic Python judgment is added.
memory.artifact_integrity_contract: Every seed memory snapshot is path-and-SHA256 bound in its manifest; seed audit rows are count-and-hash bound; the final arm manifest path-and-SHA256 binds memory_store.json and memory_store.audit.jsonl.
